changelog:
💾 Each account is saved in its own row. A request, a token refresh or a usage check now writes that one account instead of the whole list, and no longer rewrites the config or saves an automatic backup each time.
📦 The first start moves the accounts to the new table after saving a manual backup. To go back to an older version, restore that backup there.
🎛️ A switch or button in a settings row sits centred on its title and description, and the two-factor hint fits on one line.
